goal: 把家人介绍给新朋友并互相认识

n1.speaker: 新朋友 Lily
n1.line: Nice to meet you, Li Hua! Is this your family photo?
n1.lineCn: 很高兴认识你,李华!这是你的全家福吗?

grammar.name: 物主代词 my/your/his/her
grammar.note: 物主代词放在名词前表示所属关系,如 your family、my mother,相当于"……的"。

options.text: Yes, it is! This is my mother, and this is my father.
options.textCn: 是的!这是我妈妈,这是我爸爸。
options.feedback: 大方确认并开始介绍家人,介绍进行得很顺利。
mine 是名词性物主代词,不能放在名词前修饰,这里应该用 my mother。

options.text: No, this is not my family.
options.feedback: 否认照片,拒绝了介绍家人的机会。

n2.speaker: 新朋友 Lily
n2.line: They look so nice! Who is the boy next to you?
n2.lineCn: 他们看起来真好!你旁边的男孩是谁?

grammar.name: 人称代词主格
grammar.note: 作主语用 I、you、he、she、they,如 They look nice、He is my brother,后面接动词原形。

options.text: He is my brother. His name is Li Wei, and he is a student too.
options.textCn: 他是我弟弟。他叫李伟,他也是学生。
options.feedback: 用 he、his 正确介绍了弟弟的名字和身份,信息丰富。
宾语代词 me 不能作定语修饰名词,这里应该用物主代词 my。
回避问题,对方无法继续了解你的家人。

n3.speaker: 新朋友 Lily
n3.line: Oh, I see. Can you tell me about your family?
n3.lineCn: 哦,我明白了。能给我讲讲你的家人吗?

grammar.name: 指示代词 this/that/these/those
grammar.note: this 指近处、that 指远处的单数;复数用 these、those,如 These are my grandparents。

options.text: Sure! These are my grandparents, and those are my parents.
options.textCn: 当然!这些是我爷爷奶奶,那些是我爸爸妈妈。
options.feedback: 及时补救,用 these/those 清楚介绍了家人。

options.text: This is my family. It has people.
options.textCn: 这是我的家人。里面有人。
options.feedback: 信息太少太笼统,等于没介绍。
拒绝介绍家人,朋友只能放弃认识你的家人。

n4.speaker: 新朋友 Lily
n4.line: Your family sounds lovely! My name is Lily. Can you introduce me to them?
n4.lineCn: 你的家人听起来真温馨!我叫莉莉。你能把我介绍给他们吗?

grammar.name: 人称代词宾格
grammar.note: 作宾语用 me、you、him、her、them,如 introduce me to them,与主格 he、she 等相对。

options.text: Nice to meet you, Lily! Mom, Dad, this is my new friend Lily. Lily, these are my parents.
options.textCn: 很高兴认识你,莉莉!妈妈、爸爸,这是我的新朋友莉莉。莉莉,这是我爸爸妈妈。
options.feedback: 把双方互相介绍给对方,礼貌又完整,目标达成!
刚答应又马上告别,没有真正完成介绍。

options.text: You are you, and I am me.
options.feedback: 答非所问,没有进行任何介绍。

success.speaker: 新朋友 Lily
success.line: Hello, everyone! I am so happy to meet your family, Li Hua!
success.lineCn: 大家好!很高兴认识你的家人,李华!

fail1.speaker: 新朋友 Lily
fail1.line: Alright, maybe I will meet your family another day.
fail1.lineCn: 好吧,也许改天再认识你的家人。

fail2.speaker: 新朋友 Lily
fail2.line: Oh... well, nice to meet you anyway.
fail2.lineCn: 哦……好吧,认识你还是很高兴。
